# Self-test fixture for scripts/check_iam_wildcards.py: four unjustified
# wildcards that must be reported, and justified or Deny ones that must not.
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "bad" {
  statement {
    sid       = "StarAction"
    actions   = ["*"]
    resources = ["arn:aws:s3:::bucket/${replace(var.x, "-", "/")}"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "ServiceStar"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "s3:GetObject",
      "dynamodb:*",
    ]
    resources = ["arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:123456789012:table/t"]
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "StarResource"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["sqs:SendMessage"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "StarPrincipal"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["sns:Publish"]
    resources = ["arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:t"]

    principals {
      type        = "*"
      identifiers = ["*"]
    }
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "JustifiedResource"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["ecr:GetAuthorizationToken"]
    resources = ["*"] # AWS: no resource-level permissions.
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "DenyIsFine"
    effect    = "Deny"
    actions   = ["*"]
    resources = ["*"]

    principals {
      type        = "*"
      identifiers = ["*"]
    }
  }
}
